Metadata.description: Learn vibe coding with real tasks, checked against your own GitHub repository.

Home.title: Learn vibe coding with real tasks
Home.intro: Learn the basics of software development with AI. Step by step, checked against your own GitHub repository.

Tasks.title: Your tasks
Tasks.intro: Work through the tasks in order. We check many of them directly in your GitHub repository.
Tasks.criteriaHint: The task is passed when all criteria marked with * are met.
Tasks.locked: Locked – enter your GitHub repo first
Tasks.olderVersionPassed: You passed this task with version {passed}. There is now version {current} with revised content; your result stands.

pre.fileMissing: The file {pattern} is still missing from the repository.
pre.tracked: These files do not belong in the repository: {paths}. Add them to .gitignore and remove them from Git.
pre.tooFewCommits: Your repository has only {count} commits, at least {min} are needed.
pre.noMergedPullRequest: The repository has no merged pull request yet.
pre.noUrlInReadme: We found no address of your app in your README. Add the full live URL, for example on a line starting with “Live:”.
pre.urlUnreachable: We could not reach your app at {url}.
pre.noHttpsRedirect: {url} does not automatically redirect http:// to https://.
pre.secretsInFiles: We found secret keys in your files: {list}. Revoke them with the provider and create new ones.
pre.secretsInHistory: We found secret keys in your commit history: {list}. Revoke them with the provider and create new ones.
pre.secretsInBundle: We found secret keys in the code your live site delivers: {list}. Revoke them with the provider and create new ones.
pre.repoGone: Your repository is no longer publicly reachable. Check that it still exists and is public.
pre.repoEmpty: Your repository has no commits yet.
pre.repoTooLarge: Your repository is too large for the automatic check. Check whether large files like node_modules or videos got in.

Checks.queued: Waiting for the check, number {position} in the queue.
Checks.running: The AI is reading your repository. This usually takes one or two minutes.
Checks.delayed: The check is delayed. We will try again automatically.
Checks.error: The check could not be completed. This is not caused by your repository. Please try again.
Checks.notConfigured: The AI check has not been set up yet. Please contact your course leader.

limits.rateLimited: You started many checks in the last hour. Please try again later.
limits.cooldown: You just checked this task. Please wait a moment.
limits.notCheckable: This task is not checked by the AI.

register.description: Sign up to start working on the tasks.

login.title: Sign in

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox

checkEmail.resent: We sent you a new link.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter your email address. If an account exists, we will send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If an account with this address exists, the link is on its way.

reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can sign in now.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL: An account with this email address already exists.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Please confirm your email address first. We sent you a new link.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
errors.INVALID_EMAIL: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email address
verifyEmail.body: please confirm your email address for Vibe Coding Exam with this link:
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not sign up, you can ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: use this link to set a new password for Vibe Coding Exam:
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not request this, you can ignore this email.

existingAccount.subject: You already have an account
existingAccount.body: someone just tried to sign up for Vibe Coding Exam with this email address. You already have an account and can sign in here:
existingAccount.ignore: If this wasn't you, you can ignore this email. Nothing has changed on your account. If you forgot your password, you can reset it on the sign-in page.

Repo.title: Your GitHub repository
Repo.missing: Enter the address of your public GitHub repository. This unlocks the tasks we check in your repo.
Repo.label: Address of your repository
Repo.saved: Saved! Your repo is publicly accessible.
Repo.savedNoCommits: Saved – but your repo has no commits yet. Add a README, for example, and save again.

errors.invalidUrl: That doesn't look like a GitHub address. It should look like this: https://github.com/yourname/my-app
errors.notFound: We couldn't find this repo. Is the address correct and is the repo public?
errors.private: This repo is private. On GitHub, go to Settings → Danger Zone and make it “Public” so we can read it.
errors.rateLimited: GitHub is currently limiting too many requests. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.unavailable: GitHub is not reachable right now. Please try again shortly.

llm.title: Access to the AI model
llm.description: The worker reads these values for every check, no restart is needed.
llm.modelHint: The name the server reports at /v1/models.
llm.emptyUsesEnv: Leave empty to use the value from the environment variable: {value}
llm.keyStored: A key is stored encrypted and will not be shown again. Leave empty to keep it.
llm.keyFromEnv: The key from the environment variable is in use. An entry here takes precedence.
llm.keyMissing: No key has been set yet.
llm.saved: Saved. The next check uses these values.

errors.invalidUrl: This is not a valid address. It must start with http:// or https://.
errors.noEncryptionKey: The key cannot be saved because SETTINGS_ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing on the server. The other values were not saved either.

llm.testDescription: Tests the saved values. This can take one or two minutes.
llm.testFailed: The test could not be run. The server log gives the reason.
llm.testPassed: All good: the agent can work with this model.
llm.testNotPassed: Checks cannot work with these values yet.

users.limited: Showing the latest {count}. Use the search to find others.

tasks.editingDraft: You are editing the draft from {date}. Students still see the published version.
tasks.savedDraft: Draft saved. Students see the change only after publishing.
tasks.publishedCriteriaChanged: The criteria changed; whoever passed the old version stays passed.
tasks.invalid: The task cannot be saved like this:
tasks.criteriaDiffer: The criteria differ from the published version.

fields.idHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; cannot be changed later.
fields.title: Title
fields.showRepoForm: Shows the form for entering the repository
fields.scopePathsHint: One pattern per line, e.g. README* or docs/*.md.
fields.preChecksHint: A list as in task.yaml, e.g. - fileExists: "README*". Leave empty for none.

criteria.hint: The identifier stays stable so old check results remain traceable. Required criteria decide whether the task is passed.

modules.intro: Modules group the tasks on the start page. They have no versions because they influence no result.
